proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Shareholder Right to Remove Directors
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit removal of directors by majority vote of shareholders with or without cause.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on the Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders to act by written consent with the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a meeting.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Have an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy that the Chairman of the Board be an independent director whenever possible, with phase-in discretion for the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
